item: A Stop in the feed tally is said in words, not as the raw stopped_unwalked key (OPEN_QUEUE item 20 = B)
summary: tally() leaves stopped_unwalked out of the counts and appends a translated sentence ({n} entries not asked for, you stopped collection) x12 locales; tallyHover() carries the long form on the single-feed result, the batch status and the per-feed cell. tally() now returns plain text and the one innerHTML sink escapes it.
